inline_text:
Adds one entry to Open questions in `schema-agentic-use-cases.md`. 

`Parallel fan-out` is defined by timing ("concurrent sub-tasks"), `Sequential pipeline` by dependency ("dependent activities, each feeding the next"). Those aren't opposites, so a row can match neither. 20 of the 24 `Unspecified` rows in the inventory are stuck on it.

The entry lists the three readings that have come up -- timing as observed, agent count (raised by @jodeev in #39), and dependency -- along with what each one costs. It doesn't pick one.

That's deliberate. Which reading is right depends on whether these columns describe one company's implementation or the use case itself, and @zaynelt opened that question on #41. Happy to fold this into the joint decision note if that's a better home for it.

## Note

An earlier version of this PR picked dependency and reclassified 18 rows. Pulled all of that out.
